# react-remove-scroll-bar license

The npm package `react-remove-scroll-bar@2.3.8` declares MIT but omits a LICENSE file.
The accompanying license was retrieved from the official repository on 2026-11-04:
https://github.com/theKashey/react-remove-scroll-bar/blob/master/LICENSE

`tools/plugin-pack/notices.mjs` uses this explicit fallback for the bundled package.
